title: Foundations & Configuration
blurb: Understand version control models, snapshots, Git vs GitHub, installation, identity, and configuration scopes.

title: Worktree, Staging & History
blurb: Master the three states, the staging area, creating commits, reading logs, and ignoring files.

title: Undoing & Recovering Work
blurb: Amend commits, restore files, reset pointers, revert shared commits, and recover with the reflog.

title: Branching & Merging
blurb: Understand movable pointers, switching branches, fast-forward merges, and three-way merge commits.

title: Remotes & GitHub Basics
blurb: Connect remote repositories, master fetch, pull, and push, and authenticate with GitHub via PAT and SSH.

title: Pull Requests & Open Source
blurb: Practice the GitHub Flow, collaborate through Pull Requests, and contribute to upstream open source.

title: Rebasing & History Curation
blurb: Maintain clean linear histories, reword and squash with interactive rebase, and rewrite commits safely.

title: Advanced Conflict Resolution
blurb: Resolve complex merge conflicts, understand the rebase reversal, use merge tools, and automate with rerere.

title: Issues, Releases & SemVer
blurb: Organize work with GitHub Issues, Milestones, and Projects, and release with annotated tags and SemVer.

title: Debugging & Repository Hygiene
blurb: Find regressions with bisect, inspect changes with blame and pickaxe, and manage submodules and Git LFS.

title: Git Internals & Architecture
blurb: Explore the content-addressed object store, blobs, trees, commits, annotated tags, refs, and the commit DAG.

title: CI/CD & Team Workflows
blurb: Automate testing with GitHub Actions, protect branches with rulesets, and implement team branching models.
